canonical_text: Concept Cells v1.0 freezes the core: each memory is one concept cell on a whitened unit-ball geometry, and a deterministic verifier decides grounding so retrieval alone never answers.
Concept Cells v1.3 adds a knowledge library: external documents are imported, chunked, and kept fully separate from project memory so imported text can never be mistaken for a project decision.
Concept Cells v1.5 adds memory lifecycle: query history, disputed status, and conflicts_with links, so a memory's standing over time is auditable.
Concept Cells v1.6 adds project packs: isolated workspaces each with their own memory ledger, proposal queue, knowledge library, and export/import bundle.
